metadata.description_blurb: Brand marketing is not buying a follower count. It is buying a room. AI scores whether that crowd is real — growth, engagement, demographics — before you pay. HypeAuditor Audience Quality Score is 1 to 100. A hundred is not a contract.
metadata.note: ILLUSTRATE LAW: UI at B00 / B06 / B07 / B08. Body mixes Ken Burns stills with one writer beat and one names beat. GATE P before audio. 9:16 is a separate sheet, not a crop. keep_review_labels false.
metadata.source: Follower count vs room. Rails: HypeAuditor AQS 1–100 (help 2022-06-21: ER, quality audience, growth, comments authenticity). Demographics sit beside the score for brand fit. Worked example: AQS as a filter before you pay. Distinct from The Owned Face. (the spokesperson, not the crowd).

beats.narration_text: Why this is live now. Growth that looks like a hockey stick is a tell. Organic rooms add people in a weather pattern. Bought rooms arrive overnight. The model watches the graph, not the bio.

shot.prompt: Hockey-stick follower graph — the tell, not a named creator.

beats.narration_text: What it changed for operations. Engagement quality is not a like count. Identical comments, emoji piles, pods that trade praise — those are a crowd performing. Real comments argue. They ask. They show up on Tuesday.

beats.narration_text: Start with names. Growth: did the room arrive, or get poured. Engagement: are the comments from people, or from a loop. Demographics: even a real room may not be your customer. Those are not synonyms.

beats.narration_text: Worked example. HypeAuditor. Audience Quality Score, 1 to 100. It compresses engagement rate, share of real followers, growth spikes, and comment authenticity. Their own help file says: do not pick on the score alone. A person still reads the graphs.

shot.prompt: Teaching printout of a 1–100 audience quality score — not a product screenshot.

beats.narration_text: Let's recap with Claude. Follower count is not a room. Growth, engagement, demographics — three different checks. A 1-to-100 score is a filter before you pay, not a contract. Design judgment: if you only bought the count, you did not buy the room. Ask what a fake crowd would cost the brand.
